text: {"lessons":["I should make decisions based on my investment plan, not avoid selling just because admitting a purchase was mistaken feels uncomfortable.","Checking prices daily and trading frequently can encourage reactive decisions; I should avoid acting on short-term moves when they do not predict future prices.","A few months of losses or gains do not establish a reliable pattern, so I should assess my portfolio calmly and make deliberate choices rather than assume recent performance will continue."]}
